description: Color-signature RRF leg: grade-only, mixed content+grade, and a no-color control. Replace drive_file_id values with files in the eval account.

queries.notes: Grade-only. Gemini vision should not be the reason this hits; the color leg must fire.
Mixed content+grade. Content legs rank walking; color ranks the look; RRF fuses both.
No-color control. The color leg must not contribute; color_score must stay 0 on every hit.
